name: Privilege Escalation
description: Administrator-equivalent logons, user rights granted or removed, system access granted, and members added to privileged groups. Routine privilege-use events (4673, 4674, 4703), which made up nearly all of this profile's matches, are left out; search for them by Event ID when needed.
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)

event_descriptions.4718: System security access removed from an account
event_descriptions.4728: Member added to a security-enabled global group
